8c17acd074ebaaa0.description: About the Role WSP is seeking a Construction Manager Assistant to join their team in Umluj, Tabūk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the site construction management and supervision of a high-end luxury hospitality development. The successful candidate will assist the Construction Manager in overseeing contractor activities, coordinating multidisciplinary works, and monitoring project progress and quality. Key Responsibilities Support the Construction Manager in the daily supervision and management of site activities. Monitor contractor and subcontractor works to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project requirements. Supervise civil, structural, architectural, finishing, and associated building works. Coordinate with MEP, infrastructure, utilities, landscaping, and other project disciplines to resolve site interfaces. Monitor construction progress against the approved programme and highlight delays, constraints, and potential risks. Attend site inspections, coordination meetings, progress meetings, and technical discussions. Review and coordinate shop drawings, method statements, RFIs, material submissions, and other construction-related documentation. Support the Construction Manager in resolving technical and construction issues on site. Monitor workmanship and quality, assisting with the identification and close-out of NCRs, site observations, and snagging items. Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, inspectors, and other project stakeholders. Support testing, commissioning, snagging, handover, and project close-out activities. Ensure contractor activities comply with project health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements. Prepare and contribute to daily/weekly progress reports and escalate key site issues to the Construction Manager. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline. 8–12 years of overall construction experience. Consultant/PMC construction supervision experience is required. Strong site-based experience on building projects. Experience in Saudi Arabia is strongly preferred. Experience on luxury hospitality, hotels, resorts, palaces, high-end residential, commercial, or mixed-use developments is highly advantageous. Required Skills Good exposure to structural, architectural, and finishing works, with an understanding of MEP and infrastructure interfaces. Strong understanding of construction sequencing, site coordination, quality inspections, and contractor management. Ability to review construction drawings and identify coordination or constructability issues. Good communication and stakeholder-management skills. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Umluj, Tabūk, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Further details regarding compensation will be discussed during the interview process.

8c2c39edf1404d8a.description: نظرة عامة على الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن مدير عمليات تشغيل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف المباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم عمليات تشغيل المعدات المختلفة، وضمان توافر الموارد اللازمة لتحقيق أقصى قدر من الكفاءة والفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية لعمليات التشغيل. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال تخطيط وتنظيم تشغيل المعدات المتنوعة. متابعة تنفيذ التعليمات المختلفة بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية. ضمان توافر كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام التشغيلية المساهمة الفعالة في إدارة وتوجيه وتقييم عمليات التطبيق للخطط الاستراتيجية والأهداف العامة. متابعة وإدارة وتوجيه الأنشطة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، وضمان التطبيق الأمثل للأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات. متابعة عمليات إصدار التراخيص والتصاريح بما يتوافق مع المعايير والشروط المعتمدة. المشاركة في مراجعة وتطوير الأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المتبعة في مجالات تشغيل المعدات. مراجعة ودراسة احتياجات المملكة من الخطوط الحديدية فيما يتعلق بالمعدات. متابعة عمليات إعداد وتحضير تقارير العمل والإنجاز، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا المتخصصة. إحاطة الإدارة العليا بالتحديات والمستجدات المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بعمليات التشغيل. فهم عميق لعمليات تخطيط وتنظيم تشغيل المعدات. القدرة على ضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. الراتب غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

8c674f63d179a923.description: About Canonical Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. The company publishes Ubuntu, a widely used platform in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Canonical serves leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across various sectors. The company operates with a globally distributed team of over 1200 colleagues in more than 75 countries, with minimal office-based roles. Teams convene two to four times annually for in-person meetings to align on strategy and execution. The Role of Partner Sales Manager, IHV Alliances Canonical is seeking a Partner Sales Manager to join its growing IHV alliances organization. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Large OEM and Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands, including Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, and Fujitsu, are key partners for Canonical. These partners develop software-defined solutions to address global open source mandates and macro trends. Canonical’s Ubuntu platform and broader open source portfolio are integral to these partners' objectives. The Partner Sales Manager will report to the Head of IHV Alliances. Key Responsibilities Build strategic relationships and enable partner teams regarding the partnership. Generate pipeline and transact opportunities through IHV partners. Increase partner awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu. Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem. Achieve targets and objectives, and provide partner feedback. Travel regularly, including internationally, to drive partnerships in person. Align with and support internal Canonical field teams to identify, support, grow, and transact opportunities. Expand existing footprint with IHV customers with the aim of upselling to a broader portfolio. Support and contribute to broader strategy, initiatives, and key campaigns. Role Engagement The Partner Sales Manager will collaborate closely with IHV and Canonical teams across various geographies. This involves enabling IHV teams, generating and transacting opportunities, driving Canonical's agenda within IHVs, and achieving targeted results. The role requires building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical's market share and attach rate, evangelizing the partnership, and driving business interactions with various personas, from engineers to CxOs. This position will also involve running customer workshops focused on specific initiatives, attending sales events, delivering public presentations, and participating in executive engagements. Work Environment and Culture Canonical is a pioneer in global distributed collaboration. Most colleagues have worked remotely since the company's inception in 2004. The company maintains a high standard for new hires, expecting excellence and a commitment to continuous learning and skill development. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer, fostering a workplace free from discrimination. The company values diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds, recognizing their contribution to a better work environment and improved products.

8c7444d5768a5a02.job_title: B2B Software & IT Solutions Sales Specialist
8c7444d5768a5a02.description: About the Role Mastek is seeking an experienced Sales Specialist to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on driving business development and revenue growth through the sale of Oracle Applications, Cloud Solutions, and IT Consulting Services. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in IT sales, specifically with Oracle applications, and a strong background in B2B technology sales. Key Responsibilities Identify and generate new business opportunities for Oracle Applications and Cloud Services. Develop and maintain relationships with enterprise clients and key decision-makers. Promote Oracle Fusion Cloud, Oracle EBS, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) solutions. Drive sales for Oracle implementation, support, consulting, and managed services. Identify opportunities for Oracle ERP, HCM, SCM, Financials, EPM, and CRM solutions. Generate leads through LinkedIn, networking, cold calling, referrals, and industry events. Understand customer business requirements and recommend appropriate Oracle solutions. Prepare commercial proposals, RFPs, RFQs, and business presentations. Manage the complete sales lifecycle, from lead generation to negotiation and closure. Collaborate with Oracle technical consultants, solution architects, and delivery teams. Build strategic partnerships and develop new enterprise accounts. Achieve assigned revenue targets and maintain accurate sales pipeline reports. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, IT, Marketing, or a related field. 3–8 years of experience in IT Sales or Oracle Application Sales. Strong experience selling Oracle Applications and consulting services. Understanding of Oracle Fusion Cloud and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS). Experience in enterprise B2B sales and client acquisition. Knowledge of Oracle implementation, migration, enhancement, and support services. Key Skills Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills. Experience managing end-to-end sales cycles. Proficiency in CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on enterprise client engagement and sales within the Oracle ecosystem.

8cabef154eae1ce0.description: About AbbVie AbbVie is dedicated to discovering and delivering innovative medicines and solutions that address serious health issues and future medical challenges. The company aims to make a significant impact on people's lives across therapeutic areas such as immunology, oncology, and neuroscience, in addition to its Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. The Role of Product Specialist Eye Care AbbVie is seeking a Product Specialist Eye Care to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 1-3 years of experience and focuses on achieving performance, brand KPIs, and financial targets within the eye care sector. The specialist will be responsible for building and maintaining strong customer relationships and optimizing brand strategy execution. Key Responsibilities Deliver on performance, brand KPIs, financial targets, and marketing objectives. Develop pre-call plans using SMART objectives and conduct post-call evaluations to continuously improve performance. Effectively manage objections, misunderstandings, and concerns, consistently securing logical calls to action on every interaction. Proactively address customer needs, expectations, and challenges to build trusted relationships and achieve mutually beneficial agreements. Execute a call plan that meets set call metrics and optimizes coverage and frequency to key customers, maximizing access and opportunities. Continuously enhance understanding of customer needs, market landscape, competitors, market dynamics, accounts, disease states, products, and clinical expertise. Share market intelligence with in-field teams, brand teams, and managers to ensure alignment, anticipate environmental changes, and optimize brand strategy. Differentiate AbbVie’s value proposition with assigned health providers. Identify, develop, and maintain relationships with disease state experts and speakers/advocates to maximize brand performance. Required Experience Candidates should possess 1-3 years of relevant experience in a similar role. Work Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

8c87f22a6e4566ce.description: About the Role Hyundai Motor Company is seeking a Procurement Officer to manage procurement activities for manufacturing operations. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically King Abdullah Economic City, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role focuses on ensuring the timely and cost-effective sourcing of essential materials to support uninterrupted production. Job Purpose The Procurement Officer is responsible for overseeing all procurement activities related to manufacturing. This includes the sourcing of raw materials, production materials, spare parts, machinery, equipment, and other operational requirements. The primary objective is to ensure material availability while maintaining quality standards and adhering to company procurement policies. Key Responsibilities Receive and review purchase requisitions from various departments, including Production, Maintenance, and Warehouse. Source and procure raw materials, production components, spare parts, consumables, tools, and industrial equipment. Identify, evaluate, and develop relationships with suppliers and manufacturers. Request, evaluate, and compare supplier quotations based on price, quality, specifications, and delivery lead time. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules to achieve cost savings. Prepare, process, and issue Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with approved procurement procedures. Coordinate with Production Planning and Inventory Control to ensure material availability and prevent production delays. Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of materials according to production requirements. Monitor supplier performance, delivery reliability, and material quality. Support the procurement of machinery, equipment, and maintenance-related materials. Identify alternative suppliers and materials to minimize supply chain risks. Maintain updated supplier databases, purchasing records, contracts, and procurement documentation. Monitor market prices and identify opportunities to reduce procurement costs. Resolve supplier-related issues, including delivery delays, material shortages, and quality discrepancies. Ensure compliance with company procurement policies, procedures, and approval authorities. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in procurement, preferably within a manufacturing environment. Demonstrated ability to manage procurement activities efficiently and cost-effectively. Strong negotiation and supplier management skills. Proficiency in preparing and processing purchase orders and maintaining procurement documentation. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position located in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah. The role requires a dedicated presence to manage on-site procurement operations effectively. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

8caa5e0693bdd7eb.description: نبحث عن بائع متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المبيعات. ستشمل مسؤولياتك الأساسية مساعدة العملاء، عرض المنتجات بشكل جذاب، وإتمام عمليات البيع بكفاءة. إذا كنت تتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة وشغف بخدمة العملاء، ندعوك للتقديم. مهام الوظيفة: * تقديم تجربة تسوق إيجابية للعملاء. * التعرف على المنتجات وتقديم معلومات دقيقة عنها. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الفردية والجماعية. * المحافظة على ترتيب ونظافة منطقة العرض.

8c3a089a655bae3c.description: About the Role Elm Company is seeking an Engineer for its Monitoring Operations Center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the continuous health, availability, and performance of IT production infrastructure, applications, and digital services. The Engineer serves as the initial point of contact for identifying alerts, investigating service degradation, and managing incidents through resolution, adhering to established service-level agreements (SLAs). Key Responsibilities Continuously monitor production infrastructure, applications, networks, URLs, and critical digital services. Monitor dashboards, events, alerts, and service-health indicators to identify service degradation or abnormal conditions. Perform first-level analysis of monitoring alerts, validate actionable events, and distinguish them from false positives. Create or validate incidents, assign and escalate them to appropriate L2/L3 support teams, and track them until resolution. Conduct basic technical investigations, review monitoring metrics, logs, and service status, and collect relevant evidence for resolver teams. Prioritize alerts based on severity and business impact, following defined notification and escalation matrices. Maintain clear incident notes, communicate significant alerts, and provide accurate shift handovers. Support the preparation of daily and shift operational reports, identify recurring alarms, and suggest improvements to monitoring procedures. Comply with all relevant departmental policies, processes, and information security standards. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in a relevant field. Willingness to work within a shift-based operations environment. Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems. Basic server and infrastructure troubleshooting skills. Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and basic networking concepts. Familiarity with CPU, memory, disk, and network performance metrics. Basic knowledge of application and system logs. Understanding of monitoring concepts, alerts, thresholds, and events. Basic understanding of ITIL Incident Management, SLAs, and escalation procedures. Ability to read dashboards and identify abnormal behavior. Familiarity with ticketing and ITSM systems. Basic scripting knowledge in Python, PowerShell, or Bash is an advantage. Work Environment This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires working within a shift-based operations environment to ensure continuous monitoring and support.

8c5591dcbdd602e1.description: About Johnson & Johnson At Johnson & Johnson, the focus is on healthcare innovation to prevent, treat, and cure complex diseases, develop smarter and less invasive treatments, and provide personal solutions. Through expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, the company aims to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions to deliver future breakthroughs and impact human health. Role Overview The Territory Manager Orthopedics - Spine is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring 2-5 years of experience. This role is responsible for developing and executing the Spine Business Unit strategy within the assigned territory. Key objectives include achieving sales and profitability targets, expanding market share, developing strategic customer relationships, and providing high-quality clinical and technical support to healthcare professionals. Key Responsibilities Achieve annual sales, revenue, and profitability targets for the Spine Business Unit. Develop and execute territory business plans aligned with the overall Spine BU strategy. Identify new business opportunities and expand existing accounts across public and private healthcare sectors. Monitor sales performance, market trends, competitor activities, and business opportunities. Manage sales pipeline, forecasts, and conduct business reviews. Develop strong relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), spine surgeons, department heads, and hospital management. Build strategic partnerships with major accounts, including MOH, National Guard, Military Hospitals, university hospitals, and private hospitals. Identify opportunities for new product introductions (NPIs), strategic system placements, and clinical evaluations. Provide clinical and technical support during spine surgical procedures, ensuring appropriate utilization of the DePuy Synthes Spine portfolio. Conduct product demonstrations, in-service training, and clinical education. Promote the complete Spine portfolio, including pedicle screw fixation systems, deformity correction solutions, minimally invasive spine surgery (MIS), interbody solutions, cervical spine solutions, complex spine and revision procedures, biologics, bone graft solutions, and advanced surgical technologies. Ensure product availability and effective inventory management. Coordinate surgical case coverage and logistics. Manage quotations, orders, tenders, and customer documentation. Collaborate with marketing, clinical support, supply chain, finance, and regulatory teams. Ensure compliance with company policies, ethical standards, and healthcare regulations. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to achieve sales and profitability objectives. Strong understanding of the spine business unit strategy and market dynamics. Experience in developing and executing territory business plans. Proven ability to build and maintain strategic customer relationships with healthcare professionals and hospital management. Clinical and technical expertise in spine surgical procedures and related product portfolios. Knowledge of tender strategies, procurement processes, and regulatory compliance in the healthcare sector. Important Note Regarding Company Structure Johnson & Johnson has announced plans to separate its Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. This planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, regulatory approvals, and other customary conditions. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following the conclusion of the transaction, you would become an employee of DePuy Synthes, and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. Details of any planned changes would be provided by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to necessary consultation processes.

8cb7b8b0052464d4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قمم التقنية للمقاولات عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات وإعداد التقارير الدورية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعمل بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التي تقدمها الشركة. إعداد وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على جمع وتحليل البيانات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والعملاء. مهارة التفاوض وإتمام صفقات البيع. الدقة في تحرير الفواتير وتحصيل الديون. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم التقارير المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الموظف ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة وتوسيع قاعدة عملائها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم.

8c9960c4d4afe48b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للأبنية، وإعداد قوائم المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على جودة الأعمال المنجزة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية للأبنية المختلفة، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، وتحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. الإشراف على أدوات السباكة، ومتابعة العمال، وتحسين أنظمة الري والصرف في المباني الحكومية، ووضع خطط الصيانة اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير خطط الصيانة والمخططات الفنية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأدوات ومعدات الصيانة المختلفة. مهارات متابعة وإشراف على فرق العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المباني، ويكون مسؤولاً عن ضمان جودة وكفاءة أعمال الصيانة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: الرياض. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة ضمن فريق شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات.

8c25c032a3aeb9bb.description: About Dar Jana International Schools Dar Jana International Schools is seeking a Kindergarten Academic Coordinator to join their team. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with opportunities available in both Jeddah and Makkah. Role Overview The Kindergarten Academic Coordinator provides leadership, oversight, and support for all academic affairs within the preschool department. This role is central to ensuring the quality and effectiveness of instructional programs and curriculum development. Key Responsibilities Supervising, coaching, and evaluating teachers within the preschool department. Developing and refining the curriculum, ensuring alignment with the PYP framework. Utilizing data to measure the effectiveness of instructional programs and inform improvements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Demonstrated leadership capabilities in academic coordination or a similar role. Work Environment and Type This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with the company operating in both Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within an educational setting focused on early childhood development. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

8c8f33875d46fbbf.description: About Mondelēz International Mondelēz International is a global snacking company focused on leading the future of snacking. The company is seeking a Key Account Executive A to join its team in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 3-4 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Key Account Executive A will be responsible for developing professional relationships with customers, optimizing base sales, and managing new product development (NPD) and promotional activities. This role supports the execution of sales plans for assigned customers and outlets, ensuring product availability, visibility, and promotional effectiveness to contribute to sales growth and profitability. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation of account and sales plans for assigned customers. Ensure optimal product availability, visibility, and shelf placement across customer outlets. Execute merchandising standards to achieve maximum visual impact at the point of purchase. Implement and monitor promotional activities, including the placement of point-of-buying materials. Regularly visit customer outlets to check stock availability, displays, pricing, and promotional compliance. Track promotional execution and report results, gaps, and competitor activity. Build positive working relationships with customers and outlet teams. Support sales negotiations and follow up on agreed actions. Monitor sales performance and use available data to identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate with Sales, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and other internal teams to resolve operational issues. Maintain accurate records and prepare regular sales and activation reports. 8c5a5c0681446f81.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة محمد محسن سالم الصانبي وشركاه للمقاولات عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام داخل أماكن العمل من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هويات الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، وتوزيع اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في أي حوادث قد تقع. التواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة العليا بالحوادث. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة الممتلكات ضد السرقة والتخريب. القدرة على الحفاظ على النظام وتطبيق اللوائح. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل سيعمل حارس الأمن ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة في مدينة الرياض، مع التركيز على تطبيق إجراءات الأمن والسلامة لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة للجميع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه وسيتحدد بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

8ce9ff6ef2d2e8ac.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عبدالرحمن عثمان محمد العثمان وشريكه عن فني زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والعلمي وتقديم المشورة في مجال الزراعة، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الاختبارات والتجارب اللازمة لدعم الإنتاج الزراعي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء اختبارات على عينات مثل الخلايا النباتية أو الأنسجة الحيوانية. تحديد آثار طرق الإنتاج المختلفة على نمو المحاصيل والعائد. اختبار جودة المنتجات الزراعية. تحديد الطفيليات والكائنات الضارة الأخرى التي قد تؤثر على الإنتاج. تفتيش المزارع ومسحها وتقييم الظروف البيئية للنباتات والحيوانات، مثل الرطوبة والحرارة والنظافة. تقديم الدعم الفني في مجال الزراعة، وتقديم المشورة بخصوص تنفيذ إجراءات أو أساليب جديدة لزيادة الإنتاجية والعائد، والمساعدة في تنفيذها. تشغيل وصيانة المعدات البحثية اللازمة لتحليل العينات وتحديد الكائنات الحية واختبار الجودة، أو دعم الأخصائيين الزراعيين أو المزارعين. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الاختبارات والتجارب العلمية بدقة. فهم جيد للممارسات الزراعية والبيئية. بيئة العمل يعمل الفني الزراعي ضمن فريق متخصص في المنطقة الشرقية، ويكون مسؤولاً عن المهام الميدانية والمخبرية لدعم العمليات الزراعية وتحسينها. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة عبدالرحمن عثمان محمد العثمان وشريكه.

8c56627437a8a03e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مستويات التشغيل للمقاولات المعمارية عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وصيانة ومراقبة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين الكهربائيين لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها بشكل مستمر. تقديم المساعدة والدعم الفني للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تحليل المشكلات وإيجاد الحلول المناسبة. تحديد المخططات وتقدير كميات المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين المشاركين في أعمال تركيب المعدات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة الكهربائية بعد تركيبها للتأكد من مطابقتها للمخططات الأولية والمواصفات الفنية المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن برامج الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات التالفة، وتشخيص المكونات المعطوبة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ لتقليل فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي إلى الحد الأدنى. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ الأنظمة الكهربائية والمعدات ذات الصلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الهندسية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتقديم الدعم الفني وتوجيه العمال. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب العمل في هذا المنصب التواجد في المواقع والمشاريع المختلفة حسب الحاجة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

8c1d5864a04ae5bf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية، ومتابعة أنشطة الصيانة، وضمان الأداء الدقيق للمعدات بعد الإصلاح. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة، ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للبرامج المحددة. إعداد تقارير العمل وتقديمها وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير تكاليف المواد والمستلزمات اللازمة للصيانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة سراكو، حيث يساهم في الحفاظ على كفاءة وأداء المعدات الميكانيكية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة سراكو، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الوظيفة في الرياض.

8cfb33451ff1197b.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Cluster Manager of Reservations to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This contract position requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on managing reservations sales opportunities, maximizing revenue, and ensuring exceptional customer service. The role involves leading and training reservations staff to achieve revenue goals and enhance customer loyalty. Key Responsibilities Identify new reservations sales business to achieve personal and property revenue goals. Understand market conditions, competitor strengths, and economic trends to position the property effectively. Close business opportunities based on market conditions and property needs, maximizing room revenue and controlling occupancy. Respond to incoming reservations sales opportunities and negotiate contracts using creative selling abilities. Coordinate with sales and Convention Services to process rooming lists and reservation cards. Execute operational aspects of booked business, including generating proposals, writing contracts, and managing customer correspondence. Track no-show reservations, process charges, and ensure accurate billing instructions for daily arrivals. Manage waitlists and prioritize contacts for optimal customer service. Monitor reservations sales agents during phone calls and develop departmental orientation programs for new hires. Create monthly labor schedules for the reservations team. Revenue Maximization and Market Understanding The Cluster Manager Reservations is responsible for understanding the overall market landscape, including competitor analysis, economic trends, and supply and demand dynamics. This includes identifying new business opportunities to achieve revenue goals and closing the best opportunities for the property. The role also involves monitoring same-day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and manage property occupancy effectively. Customer Service Excellence A core aspect of this role is to drive customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience. This involves providing service to customers to grow their share of the account, executing exemplary customer service to ensure satisfaction before and during their program or event, and setting a positive example for guest relations. The manager will also handle guest complaints and disputes following established instant pacification procedures. Human Resources and Training This position involves managing and conducting human resource activities for the reservations sales team. Responsibilities include monitoring reservations sales agents during phone calls, developing and implementing a departmental orientation program for new employees, and utilizing available on-the-job training tools. The Cluster Manager Reservations will also be responsible for creating monthly labor schedules for the team. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in reservations sales or a related field. Demonstrated ability to solicit and manage reservations sales-related opportunities. Proficiency in negotiating and creative selling. Strong understanding of market dynamics and revenue maximization strategies. Ability to provide exceptional customer service and drive customer loyalty. Experience in training and managing staff.

8c3d574941ecba27.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان كفاءة وسلامة المباني من خلال تنفيذ خطط الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، وإدارة المواد والموارد اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة الأعمال المنجزة وتدقيقها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطط الصيانة الدورية لمختلف المباني، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية حول الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة المباني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة مجموعة المجال العربي في مدينة بريدة بالقصيم، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالجودة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: القصيم. المدينة: بريدة. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

8c4f06948cdb0d9f.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Manager Outreach Engagement to lead the team responsible for member outreach, education, enrollment, and ongoing engagement in CareConnect health programs. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead proactive member outreach to introduce CareConnect services and explain program benefits. Ensure eligible members receive timely contact and follow-up to support enrollment in appropriate programs. Identify members' specific needs, goals, and pain points to develop targeted outreach plans. Allocate team and individual targets, manage workloads, and ensure adequate staffing coverage. Conduct regular coaching, performance reviews, and development discussions, addressing training needs and performance gaps. Oversee initial and repeat consultation bookings, monitor completion and no-shows, and manage reminders, cancellations, and rebooking. Develop and oversee an efficient, comprehensive onboarding process tailored to member needs, communicating timelines to new members. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (*, RCM, Medical team, technical teams) to create a seamless onboarding experience. Coordinate with Care Navigators and ICS to support member follow-up, track pending services, and escalate unresolved issues. Monitor and analyze team performance across various metrics, including calls, reachability, enrollment, bookings, consultation completion, retention, and quality. Maintain accurate dashboards and provide timely performance reports, identifying gaps and implementing corrective actions. Support the implementation of AI-powered engagement tools and identify system enhancement requirements based on operational gaps and member needs. Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT), validate workflows, and coordinate team training and adoption of new systems. Monitor interaction quality, documentation accuracy, and compliance with approved processes and agreed SLAs. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Team Leadership and Operational Management This role involves leading a team to ensure adherence to approved workflows and service standards. The Manager Outreach Engagement will drive consultation bookings and completion, support member retention across follow-up cycles, and ensure a consistent member experience through effective team management and coordination with clinical and operational teams. Performance Monitoring and Quality Improvement The role requires continuous monitoring and analysis of team performance, maintaining accurate dashboards, and providing timely reports to the department lead. It also involves identifying performance gaps, implementing corrective actions, and supporting the integration of digital enablement tools and system enhancements to improve productivity and member experience. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

8c7dc4b90eff8b63.description: About RAWAJ RAWAJ is a prominent Saudi retail company operating across e-commerce and retail distribution, with a strategic focus on growth and market expansion within Saudi Arabia. The company is seeking a Chief Executive Officer to lead its operations in Riyadh. Role Overview The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) will be responsible for driving the company’s overall business strategy, profitability, and operational excellence. This full-time role encompasses leadership across e-commerce platforms and retail distribution operations, overseeing commercial performance, supply chain, digital transformation, financial management, and organizational development to ensure sustainable growth and a seamless customer experience across all channels. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute the company’s business strategy to achieve sustainable growth, profitability, and market expansion. Identify new revenue streams, business opportunities, and strategic partnerships across e-commerce and retail distribution. Strengthen competitive positioning within the Saudi retail market through market intelligence and industry trend analysis. Oversee sales, marketing, e-commerce, and distribution strategies to meet revenue and profitability targets. Drive customer acquisition, retention, and engagement while enhancing the customer experience across all sales channels. Lead the growth and performance of digital commerce platforms, optimizing online sales, conversion rates, and digital marketing effectiveness. Oversee retail distribution, logistics, warehousing, procurement, inventory management, and order fulfillment. Improve operational efficiency, supply chain performance, cost optimization, and service delivery. Manage the company’s P&L, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, and overall financial performance. Establish performance KPIs, monitor business results, and implement initiatives to improve revenue, margins, and profitability. Lead digital transformation initiatives and leverage technology and data analytics to enhance business performance. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing executive team, fostering accountability, innovation, and collaboration. Oversee workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership development, and organizational effectiveness. Maintain strong relationships with shareholders, board members, key suppliers, distributors, and strategic partners. Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi regulations and establish effective corporate governance, internal controls, and risk management practices. Qualifications and Experience 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in retail, e-commerce, distribution, consumer goods, or a related industry. Proven track record as a CEO, Managing Director, General Manager, or senior executive leading a sizeable business or multiple business functions. Demonstrated success in driving business growth, revenue expansion, and P&L performance. Strong experience across e-commerce and retail distribution, covering both digital and traditional sales channels. Solid understanding of the Saudi retail market, consumer behavior, and competitive landscape. Proven expertise in commercial strategy, sales leadership, marketing, and customer experience. Strong knowledge of supply chain management, procurement, inventory optimization, logistics, and distribution operations. Experience leading digital transformation, e-commerce growth initiatives, and technology-enabled business improvements. Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and profitability optimization. Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing teams and drive organizational change. Excellent strategic thinking, decision-making, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Fluency in English and Arabic, both written and spoken. A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing, or a related field is required; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves leading a dynamic team within a growth-focused retail and e-commerce environment.

8c973e4304befc80.description: About Air Products and BHIG Air Products is a global leader in industrial gases, committed to driving innovation through its people and collective experience. The company focuses on creating solutions that support various sectors, from space exploration to healthcare and large-scale industrial facilities. This role is within BHIG—Blue Hydrogen Industrial Gases, a regional development and investment joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Air Products Qudra. BHIG leverages the strengths of both entities to advance industrial innovation and operational excellence in Saudi Arabia and the broader region, with a focus on low-carbon hydrogen production to support clean energy goals. Role Overview: HYCO Operator The HYCO Operator will report to the HYCO Shift Supervisor and is responsible for performing field and DCS operations independently at a world-scale HYCO Steam Methane Reformer facility. This full-time position is based in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, requiring 5-10 years of experience. The Operator L1 will execute daily tasks, including preparing and implementing safety work permits, LOTO procedures, and completing operational preventative maintenance activities. Additionally, the role involves assisting maintenance and engineering teams with corrective maintenance activities. Key Responsibilities Maintain a safe work environment and demonstrate leadership in company and industry safe work processes, ensuring proper documentation for safety activities. Operate the HYCO Steam Methane Reformer, CO2 recovery units, and ancillary equipment, including water treatment units, according to Work Instruction Procedures. Manage the pipeline network for hydrogen, steam, and CO2 supply to customers, including oxygen and nitrogen pipeline products, safely and efficiently. Provide operational support and guidance during plant commissioning, maintaining accurate document control and monitoring quality assurance initiatives. Ensure compliance with process safety, MOC’s, OPHR requirements, and environmental/regulatory standards. Manage plant production efficiently based on input from Plant Management and Production Engineering to meet safety, reliability, and profitability targets. Report shift production progress and plant status to the Shift Supervisor, offering operational solutions for shortfalls. Support maintenance and engineering teams in maintaining plant reliability through preventive maintenance execution and coordination of corrective maintenance activities. Participate in investigations and Root Cause Analysis to identify and implement sustainable corrective actions. Facilitate operational excellence and customer satisfaction through productivity, reliability, quality, and continuous improvement initiatives. Train new operators and participate in board reviews for lower-level operators. Assist in the startup and commissioning of new sites in the region and train newly hired workforces as needed. Required Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant operational role. Expert-level knowledge in specified skills areas with multiple areas of responsibility. Solid technical knowledge of designated plant processes. Ability to demonstrate a 4S culture and practice it in day-to-day activities. Proficiency in writing SWIMs, JSAs, and other operational documentation. Capability to take a leadership role in TAR / Outages / Start-ups. In-depth knowledge of listed systems, demonstrated by completing a task list. Work Environment and Expectations The HYCO Operator will work independently on shifts as a fully contributing member of the operations team. This role requires a focus on activities such as Best Practice Coordinator or SWIM Coordinator. The position demands adherence to BHIG standards and global best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality, and overall customer service. Effective communication with other shifts is essential to maintain continuity for safe and reliable operations. The operator will also maintain customer communications at the board level to ensure demand rates are satisfied while maximizing facility efficiency and profitability.

8ca25b4eacd2fd82.description: تعلن ثمار المتحدة لخدمات الأعمال عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى: أخصائية مبيعات ( مكتبية ) 📍 مقر العمل: الرياض - قرطبة نبحث عن أخصائية مبيعات تمتلك مهارات تواصل وإقناع عالية، وقادرة على التعامل باحترافية مع العملاء وتحويل الفرص البيعية إلى مبيعات ناجحة. المهام الوظيفية: - التواصل مع العملاء المحتملين وفهم احتياجاتهم وتحديد الخدمة المناسبة لهم. - متابعة مراحل البيع من أول تواصل وحتى إغلاق الصفقة وما بعد البيع. - تحديد ومتابعة الأهداف البيعية الشهرية للفريق والعمل على تحقيقها. - متابعة الأداء بشكل مستمر وتحديد نقاط الضعف والعمل على تحسينها مع حل المشكلات والعوائق - تحليل نتائج المبيعات وتحديد أسباب انخفاض الأداء واقتراح الحلول والإجراءات التصحيحية. - التنسيق مع الأقسام الداخلية لضمان سرعة معالجة طلبات العملاء واستمرارية الخدمة. - تقديم تقارير أسبوعية وشهرية عن أداء المبيعات والفرص والنتائج. المتطلبات: - خبرة من سنة إلى سنتين في مجال المبيعات. - إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية شرط أساسي. - مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والإقناع والتفاوض. - القدرة على المتابعة وتنظيم العملاء والفرص البيعية. تفاصيل الوظيفة: - 8 ساعات عمل يوميًا. - 6 أيام عمل أسبوعيًا. - العمل من مقر الشركة في الرياض، ولا يوجد عمل ميداني. - الراتب يحدد بعد المقابلة. - نظام عمولات وحوافز بالإضافة إلى الراتب.

8cab16dda1fd4c87.description: About Air Products Qudra and BHIG Air Products Qudra (APQ) is a joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Air Products Qudra, forming BHIG—Blue Hydrogen Industrial Gases. This regional development and investment joint venture leverages the combined strengths of both entities to drive industrial innovation and operational excellence across Saudi Arabia and the wider region. BHIG is focused on supporting clean energy goals through low-carbon hydrogen production. Role Overview: HyCO Shift Supervisor The HyCO Shift Supervisor is responsible for managing and supervising the operating staff for a world-scale HyCO Steam Methane Reformer facility for BHIG Company in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience in relevant operations. The supervisor will oversee day-to-day operations, ensuring daily operational targets are met and maintaining safe and reliable site operations through collaboration with HSSE, Maintenance, and Engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Manage and supervise operations staff, including shift supervisors and operators, for the HyCO Steam Methane Reformer facility. Conduct daily customer production meetings and ensure achievement of daily operational targets. Interface with HSSE, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to ensure safe and reliable site operation. Ensure operations staff are properly trained and execute daily tasks such as preparing safety work permits, LOTO, and completing preventative maintenance activities. Assist maintenance and engineering teams in preparing and executing corrective maintenance activities. Provide and maintain a safe work environment, demonstrating leadership in company and industry safe work processes. Ensure proper implementation and documentation of safety-related activities, adhering to company HSSE policy and procedures. Meet all environmental regulatory requirements and ensure BHIG standards and global best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality, and customer services are met. Provide direction to staff for the HyCO Steam Methane Reformer unit and ancillary equipment, including STG and water treatment facilities. Operate the unit and pipeline network for hydrogen, steam, and CO2 as required. Provide guidance based on technical feedback from Engineering and Maintenance for troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and test activities. Support and guide operations during commissioning, startup, and shutdown of plants. Maintain accurate document control and monitor quality assurance initiatives. Manage plant production efficiently based on data-driven decisions to achieve safety and reliability targets. Report shift production progress and plant status, providing operational solutions for shortfall areas. Provide effective leadership, coaching, and motivation to operations teams to achieve operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Develop, train, and promote top-performing personnel. Establish and maintain close working relationships with engineering and maintenance personnel. Participate in and lead incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis, identifying and implementing sustainable corrective actions. Act as the Single Point of Contact for internal issues of the HyCO unit, representing BHIG and coordinating internal resources. Provide timely progress updates to customers and maintain relationships with customer upper-level managers. Execute other duties as assigned by reporting managers. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in relevant operations. Demonstrated leadership in safety work processes. Ability to provide technical direction and guidance for complex industrial gas operations. Experience in managing and training operational staff. Proficiency in preparing and implementing safety work permits, LOTO, and conducting preventative maintenance. Work Environment and Commitment This full-time position is based in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic industrial environment focused on clean energy goals. The role requires a strong commitment to safety, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction, working within a team-oriented structure that values open communication and performance-driven results.

8c222186fa8402c3.description: About the Role Echelon is seeking a Principal AI Data Centres to lead its infrastructure partnerships and the business built on them. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer. The Principal will be responsible for defining how Echelon advises and builds with its partners, ensuring these positions are commercially viable. Key Responsibilities Establish and maintain long-term relationships with operators and suppliers, ensuring shared plans, clear commitments, and effective governance. Secure large capacity programs with partners, structuring deals across the entire lifecycle to reward Echelon for added value. Identify new customers requiring capacity, including AI providers, hyperscalers, national programs, and large enterprises, and identify partners to expand Echelon's delivery capabilities. Build and lead the team, developing the operating model to define Echelon's internal activities, partner responsibilities, and procurement strategies, including cost, governance, and insourcing decisions. Implement quality gates, operating procedures, and liability lines, agreed with partners, to ensure all Echelon sites meet industry benchmarks. Develop Echelon's team capability, fostering growth from engineering and build management into network, security, and facility operations. Create robust business cases for new capacity, covering demand, power, chip-generation ramp, capital structure, offtake, and returns, designed to withstand scrutiny from customers, partners, and investors. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in building or leading data centre, cloud, or power programs for operators, developers, hyperscalers, or advisory firms. Demonstrated leadership in managing partnerships between companies of varying sizes and cultures, ensuring commitment from inception to delivery. In-depth understanding of commercial and financial deal structuring, project models, capital and operating costs, revenue share, offtake, and returns. Knowledge of how AI workloads impact power density, liquid cooling, chip generation pace, and their effects on design, cost, and schedule. Experience in hiring and leading specialist teams, building capabilities from initial hires and projects, and setting scalable standards. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to hyperscale and AI campuses of 100 MW and above, covering aspects from site and power to handover and operations. Experience with licensed or franchised operating models where design and operating standards are delivered by another entity. Familiarity with infrastructure investors, project finance, or joint ventures. Work Approach and Values The successful candidate will prioritize customer outcomes, demonstrate ownership of results, and communicate complex systems clearly. This role requires comfort with ambiguity, the ability to make progress with incomplete information, and a long-term building mindset. The Principal will also be expected to develop others and build capability with customers. A key aspect of the work approach involves starting from the problem, learning continuously, moving quickly from brief to result, and applying rigor in testing claims and explaining choices. The role demands confidence balanced with humility, autonomy in decision-making, resourcefulness, and situational leadership. Proficiency in using AI tools for planning, modeling, and decision-making is also expected. Compensation and Environment This position offers a base salary along with housing, transport, and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through an employee equity program. Specific terms will be shared at the offer stage. Regular travel to customer sites and some travel to partner teams in the United States is required.

8c26abb4ca9e0450.description: About Shory Shory is a digital platform focused on redefining insurance through technology. It aims to simplify complex insurance processes into user-friendly experiences. Shory operates as part of First Tech, a technology company that builds and scales digital platforms across financial services and other industries. Founded in the UAE in 2021, Shory has developed into a high-growth digital platform providing transparent, customer-first insurance solutions. The Role Shory is seeking a Business Analyst to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Region. This full-time role involves bridging business needs with technology solutions by analyzing requirements, optimizing processes, and translating strategic objectives into scalable digital solutions. The Business Analyst will partner with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products and business initiatives throughout the product development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, validate, and document business, functional, and technical requirements. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and feasibility studies to identify business opportunities and support strategic decision-making. Translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications for development teams. Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, UX/UI Designers, QA teams, and business stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle. Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and continuous improvement. Evaluate operational, financial, and technology-related risks, providing recommendations for mitigation. Support the creation of wireframes, prototypes, process diagrams, and workflow documentation. Produce and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), user stories, use cases, process maps, sequence diagrams, scope documents, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans. Support project planning by tracking milestones, maintaining issue logs, monitoring progress, and keeping documentation up to date. Facilitate workshops, stakeholder meetings, and requirements gathering sessions. Collaborate with QA teams during testing cycles and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Monitor product performance post-implementation, gather user feedback, and recommend enhancements. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this position should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in business analysis. The role requires a professional who can effectively align business objectives with technological solutions and manage requirements across the product development lifecycle. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of business initiatives and product development.

8c3216fb425742fb.description: Job Overview مساندة للتشغيل والصيانة is seeking an experienced Facilities Manager to oversee the daily operations of assigned sites in Al Ula. This full-time role focuses on ensuring that buildings, assets, and services operate safely and efficiently, adhering to contract requirements and company standards. Key Responsibilities Manage both hard and soft Facilities Management (FM) services across assigned sites, including MEP, HVAC, cleaning, security, landscaping, and pest control. Plan and supervise preventive, corrective, and reactive maintenance programs to ensure operational continuity. Monitor subcontractor performance against defined contract scopes, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Prepare and control site budgets, generate cost reports, and manage procurement requests. Ensure full compliance with Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements, Civil Defense regulations, and internal company standards. Prepare and present monthly performance reports to management. Lead, schedule, and develop site supervisors, technicians, and support staff. Drive initiatives focused on energy efficiency and continuous improvement within facilities operations. Required Experience Candidates should possess 6 to 10 years of experience in facilities management or a related field, demonstrating a strong understanding of operational leadership and service delivery. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Ula, requiring on-site presence to manage daily operations and teams effectively. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

8c41128a811ff5b3.description: About the Role Team Saudi is seeking a Senior Manager Psychology to lead sport psychology services. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, and focuses on enhancing athletes’ mental skills, resilience, and performance consistency within Team Saudi’s Olympic and emerging sports programs. The position involves providing direct psychological support to athletes and coaches, implementing mental skills training, and contributing to wellbeing initiatives.
